study.question: Does the historical-click partition retain its advantage when both centroid and deviation energy are retained, and does the partition effect interact with task-conditioned residual routing?
study.hypothesis: Round44 click-stratum means outperform shifted-stratum means, whereas round45 click-stratum deviations underperform shifted deviations. A semantic-centroid explanation predicts that preserving the true-click centroid while reversing deviations, H(A)=P(A)-(I-P)(A)=2P(A)-A, will outperform an equally sized artificial partition at unchanged group/block action energy. Crossing true/shifted partitions with task/shared residual routing tests whether task conditioning attenuates that partition dependence. This is an attribution diagnostic, not a claim that reflection is a new model family or that it will beat the unchanged incumbent.

study.proposed_difference: For each sample, ten-position block and two valid-position strata, compute the existing masked FP32 projection P onto stratum-constant action vectors; feed 2P(A)-A only to action coordinates of match-summary rows0/4. Invalid positions retain their old values and cannot contribute. Both strata retain their sums, Frobenius energies and within-stratum pairwise distances in exact arithmetic; reflection is an involution, not action removal. Four standalone modules cross click versus count-matched rotated-click membership with task versus equal-bank shared routing. No new parameters, RNG, state, training hook, normalization fit or information source.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast per routing: D_r=AUC(reflect_click_r)-AUC(reflect_shift_r)>0 if semantic centroid preservation matters beyond projection energy loss. Report both effects without selecting the favorable routing.

Predeclared interaction I=D_task-D_shared is expected negative: previous rotate/mean partitions show a smaller partition penalty under task routing. Either sign must be reported; one seed is preliminary.

True-click reflection should retain more of the aligned observed-stop reference performance than shifted reflection. Compare g1-r0037-match_observed_stop_task/shared; no prespecified claim of incumbent improvement or exact equivalence.

At fixed parameters only stopped action summary rows0/4 can change; input group sums, energy and pairwise distances are preserved, and applying reflection twice reconstructs valid action inputs within declared numerical bounds.

Backward-compatibility bridge with summary_stratum_operator=residual must reproduce each corresponding materialized round45 cell after dropping the new default; old mean/rotate branches must remain source-identical. Initial zero-bank prediction equality alone is insufficient.
falsifiers: D_task or D_shared near zero or reversed after nontrivial, certified interventions weakens the partition-preserving semantic-centroid account. Reversal is counterevidence, not a failed execution.
A zero or positive repeated interaction weakens the directional claim that task routing attenuates partition sensitivity; absent authorized repetitions do not establish an interaction.
Near-zero reflected residuals, homogeneous/singleton strata or unchanged contracted match summaries make a null result non-identifying; report lack of intervention rather than centroid sufficiency.

Mask leakage, any changed ordinary branch, different parameters/initialization/Dice population, bridge mismatch, nonfinite outputs or failed energy/sum checks invalidates a controlled comparison; preserve execution and cost receipts.

A partition advantage can survive energy preservation through coefficient covariance or optimization effects. Without further matching and repetition, it does not identify a biological/causal user mechanism, full feedback necessity or a production effect.

This reversal motivates reflection, but projection energy and covariance are not yet separated. Prior tensor diagnostics are not_requested, so do not promote prior outcomes to controlled support.

validation_plan.numerical_gates: Pre-score bounds: integer masks/counts/unchanged branches exact. FP32 group/reflection invariants abs<=2e-5+2e-5*maxabs(reference); BF16<=0.02+0.02*maxabs(reference). Probability abs<=0.002. Bridge nonzero gradients relative L2<=1e-4 FP32 or0.05 BF16 with1e-12 denominator floor, plus elementwise near-zero bounds. Report measured maxima/RMS without widening thresholds after scores. Failed/unavailable tensor certification means exploratory performance only; no controlled attribution.
